name: Spreading Fire
description: An internal actor that manages fire spreading to nearby tiles, such as grass ignited by fire.

fields.name: Spreading Interval?
fields.description: Controls a timer used by the spreading fire. A value of 0 results in 30; other values are multiplied by 2.

fields.name: Fire Mode?
fields.description: Controls fire behavior and tile placement. Values 5 and 6 prevent the fire from spawning additional spreading fire actors.

fields.name: Parameter?
fields.description: Passed to tile operations and inherited by spawned fire actors. A value of 15 is treated as -1.
